items.title: AWS Systems Manager Agent Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Bypass Port-Forwarding Restrictions
items.description: A critical vulnerability in the AWS Systems Manager Agent could let authenticated attackers bypass remote-host port-forwarding restrictions and access sensitive link-local services, including the Amazon EC2 Instance Metadata Service. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-89049, affects Amazon SSM Agent versions earlier than 3.3.4851.0 and has been fixed in version 3.3.4851.0. AWS Systems Manager Agent…

items.title: Why Patch Automation Needs Brakes, Not Just an Accelerator
items.description: Patch automation can help IT teams keep pace with growing update volumes, but deploying faster also means bad updates can spread faster. items.title: Malicious Twitch Extension Exposes OAuth Tokens of 30,000 Chrome and Firefox Users
items.description: A browser extension promoted as a Twitch viewing helper has been found sending live account tokens through servers controlled by its operator. The add-on, called “Twitch Enhanced Viewer | JeetBot,” was available to Chrome and Firefox users and advertised conveniences such as ad blocking, higher-quality playback, region-unlocked streams, and automatic channel-point collection. items.title: WhatsApp’s New Restricted Chat Feature Locks Conversation on Your Primary Phone
items.description: WhatsApp is developing a new privacy control called Restricted Chat that will keep selected conversations accessible only from a user’s primary mobile phone. The feature is designed to prevent protected chats from syncing to WhatsApp Web, desktop sessions, and secondary phones linked to the same account. WhatsApp identified the capability in Android beta version 2.26.36.5. […] The post…
